title: Anti-Narcotics Force Adaptation and Enforcement Order 2000

sections.shortTitle: Anti-Narcotics Force Adaptation and Enforcement Order 2000
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

{\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg1252\deff0\deflang1033{\fonttbl{\f0\froman\fcharset0 Times New Roman;}}
\viewkind4\uc1\pard\qc\b\f0\fs24 ANTI-NARCOTICS FORCE \par
(ADAPTATION AND ENFORCEMENT) ORDER, 2000\par
\pard\qj\par
\pard\qc [Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 12th August, 2000]\par
\pard\qj\b0\par
\b S.R.O.557(I)/2000, dated 8-8-2000.--\b0 -An Order to adapt and enforce the Anti-Narcotics Force Act, 1997 (III of 1997), in the Northern Areas;\par
\par
Now, therefore, the Government of Pakistan is pleased to make the following order:--\par
\par
\b 1. Short title, extent and commencement.-\b0 -This Order may be called the Anti-Narcotics Force (Adaptation and Enforcement) Order, 2000.\par
\par
(2) It extends to the whole of the Northern Areas.\par
\par
(3) It shall come into force at once.\par
\par
\b 2. Adaptation and enforcement of Anti-Narcotics Force Act, 1997.\-\b0 -The Anti-Narcotics Force Act, 1997 (III of 1997), as in force in Pakistan immediately before the commencement of this Order and all Rules, Notifications and Orders made or issued thereunder are adapted and shall, as far as practicable mutatis mutandis, apply and be in force in the Northern Areas.\par
\par
}
